query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

message.content:
Based on the 2016 debates, here's a script for how a Hillary vs Trump rap battle might have gone down:

---

**"EPIC RAP BATTLES OF THE PRESIDENCY"**

**HILLARY CLINTON:**

Yo, they call me H-Rod, Secretary of State,
I got forty years of policy on my debate plate.
You inherited millions, called it a "small loan,"
Your daddy built your empire while you sat on the throne.

You call women dogs, pigs, you grade 'em on ten,
I'm here with the resume, where do I begin?
Children's Defense Fund, healthcare reform,
While you were hosting pageants in your misogyny storm.

You say "Make America Great," but your hats made in China,
Your university scammed students—man, that's vagina?
I mean predatory, your businesses fail,
Four bankruptcies later and you're still out on bail... from reality!

**DONALD TRUMP:**

WRONG! Let me tell you something, nasty woman in red,
Your husband signed NAFTA, left Michigan dead.
You got stamina? Please, you coughed through a speech,
I'm packing rallies ten thousand deep on the beach.

You deleted 33,000, bleach bit the server,
If I did that they'd call me a traitor, a deserver...
Of prison! But you? "Extremely careless," they said,
Crooked Hillary, the FBI's walking dead.

I bring jobs back from Mexico, build that wall,
You're globalist elite, sold us out to 'em all.
WikiLeaks exposed you, the emails don't lie,
John Podesta's risotto while America cried!

**HILLARY CLINTON:**

*adjusts earpiece*

You want to talk emails? Let's talk about taxes,
Where are your returns? What's with all the relaxes?
You're not as rich as you claim, that's the art of your deal,
A billion-dollar loss—man, that's some unreal... estate.

You mocked a disabled reporter, attacked a Gold Star dad,
The Khan family sacrificed what you never had.
Five deferments for bone spurs, what a convenient pain,
While McCain was in Hanoi, you were profiting in vain.

And that tape on the bus? "Locker room talk"?
Twelve women came forward—time to walk the walk.
You said you'd grab women, now you're grabbing at straws,
I'm with her, she's with us, that's the people's cause!

**DONALD TRUMP:**

*leans into mic*

Bill Clinton was abusive to women, ask Juanita,
I brought your husband's accusers—yeah, I had to seat ya.
In the front row! You attacked them, you vicious machine,
The war on women? You lived it, you queen.

Alicia Machado—check out sex tape! (I tweeted at 3 AM, no escape)
Your campaign baited me, I took it, I'm real,
Not polished politician, I say what I feel.

You want open borders, 550% increase in Syrian refugees,
I'll ban 'em, extreme vetting, America first, if you please.
You called half my supporters a basket of deplorables,
At least they're not in your basket of unaccountables!

**HILLARY CLINTON:**

*pointing*

I'll take the high road while you take the low one,
Your Putin bromance? That's the real smoking gun.
Seventeen agencies say Russia hacked for you,
You're a puppet! "No puppet, no puppet"—who's the puppet? It's you!

I'll accept the results 'cause I respect democracy,
You'll "keep us in suspense"? That's hypocrisy!
Peaceful transfer of power, that's 240 years strong,
You're unfit, you're unhinged, and your mic's still on.

**DONALD TRUMP:**

*breathing heavily*

Such a nasty woman. The system's rigged, everyone knows,
The media, the establishment, all my foes.
But I'll keep you in suspense, that's my prerogative,
Maybe I'll accept it, maybe I'll get explosive.

I got the best words, believe me, they're tremendous,
Your "public and private positions"? That's offensive!
I'm the law and order candidate, you're the status quo,
November 8th, watch the Rust Belt go...

**BOTH:**

*beat drops*

**TRUMP:** TRUMP!
**HILLARY:** CLINTON!
**TRUMP:** TRUMP!
**HILLARY:** CLINTON!

**ANNOUNCER:**

WHO WON? WHO'S NEXT? YOU DECIDE!

**EPIC RAP BATTLES... OF THE PRESIDENCY!**

---

**Sources:**
1. https://globalnews.ca/news/3051825/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-the-most-memorable-cringe-worthy-moments-from-the-2016-campaign/
2. https://globalnews.ca/news/3015351/presidential-debate-2016-what-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton-said-on-iraq-syria-and-mexico/
3. https://mashable.com/video/epic-rap-battles-of-history-donald-trump-hillary-clinton
4. https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/11/06/election-2016-the-10-pivotal-gaffes-by-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton/
5. https://epicrapbattlesofhistory.fandom.com/wiki/Donald_Trump_vs_Kamala_Harris
